Validate object(s) against schema and check references.

This command validates objects against their schema definitions and checks
that all references are valid. It can validate:
  - A specific object by ID
  - All objects of a specific kind (--kind)
  - All in-scope project objects (default when neither an ID nor --kind is given; same as --all)

  Validate a specific object
  zqk system validate BLI-657
  Validate all backlog items
  zqk system validate --kind backlog_item
  Validate all in-scope objects (default)
  zqk system validate
  Validate all (explicit)
  zqk system validate --all
  Attempt to fix validation errors
  zqk system validate --fix

Usage:
  zqk system validate [object-id] [flags]

Flags:
      --all                     Validate all objects
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --fix                     Attempt to fix validation errors
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --kind string             Validate objects of specific kind
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
